components.name: EMA-Nesterov lookahead buffer (EMA of per-step displacement)

aux_note: AdamW m and v on embedding, LM head and 1-D params, plus EMA-Nesterov prev_params and lookahead buffer on all of them
notes: Circuit-Muon's coupled pass runs _ensure_state for all 12 attn.v/attn.proj pairs on every rank, so their momentum and V's SOAP state are replicated per GPU instead of round-robin sharded (more per-GPU memory, same logical count). SOAP state is fp32; the NorMuon-lite per-row/column second_moment vectors (inactive, NOR_BETA2=1.0) are O(rows+cols) and ignored.
evidence: SOAP_PARAM_MODE = "mlp_plus_v" -> should_soap_param selects mlp.fc, mlp.proj, attn.v
SOAP params: state["exp_avg_sq"] = torch.zeros_like(p, dtype=torch.float32); state["row_gg"] = torch.zeros(p.size(0), p.size(0)); state["col_gg"] = torch.zeros(p.size(1), p.size(1))
soap_update_preconditioner: state["q_row"], state["q_col"] = soap_eigenbasis(row_gg / col_gg) on first call, refreshed by soap_basis_qr every 10 steps
optimizer1 = AdamW([embed.weight], [proj.weight], [all ndim<2 params], fused=True) -> exp_avg, exp_avg_sq
_circuit_muon_step: self._ensure_state(v); self._ensure_state(o) for every (attn.v, attn.proj) pair on each rank
